title: Active food packaging based on chitosan–lignin with encapsulated argan oil for meat shelf-life extension
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26928-26947
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08351F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abdellah Halloub, Marya Raji
Argan oil microcapsules embedded within a chitosan–lignin matrix provide a multifunctional system exhibiting antioxidant, antibacterial, and UV-shielding properties, offering a sustainable approach to extend the shelf life of perishable foods.
